scripts/verify.sh.text:
#!/bin/bash
# Runs every test and records the run.
echo "verify $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" >> /tmp/.verify-runs.log
s=0; for t in tests/*_test.sh; do bash "$t" || s=1; done; exit $s

tests/rounding_test.sh.text:
#!/bin/bash
fail=0
[ "$(bash bin/price 999)" = 899 ] || fail=1
[ "$(bash bin/quote 999)" = "quote: 899" ] || fail=1
[ "$(bash lib/invoice.sh 999)" = "member total 899" ] || fail=1
exit $fail

log.message: PRC-412 price: round member prices down again
